summary: The diff implements several of the required features: React Query cache invalidation in admin mutations (REQ-2), session error handling with user-friendly toasts (REQ-3), and frontend queries pulling data from the backend actor (REQ-1 frontend side). However, there is no evidence of backend/main.mo being modified for stable variable declarations (REQ-4), and the diff shows no Motoko file changes at all. REQ-4 cannot be confirmed as implemented.
